title: May 2026: Slide generation, activity folders, multidimensional rubrics, and more!
summary: Our May 2026 updates, including slide generation, customizable videos, activity folders, multi-dimensional rubrics, images in documents, and updated AI models.
body_markdown:
Happy May 🍀


The theme for this month's updates are creativity and organization, from slide generation and images in documents, to activity folders and multidimensional rubrics.


Check out our May 2026 updates below


## 🎞️ Slide presentations


Create polished slide decks in minutes without leaving Flint. Just say what you need and Sparky generates themed slides with AI visuals tailored to your learning objectives. You can even attach your syllabus or lesson materials to give Sparky extra context for more relevant content.[Learn more about slide generation.](https://help.flintk12.com/en/articles/14478771-slide-generation-in-flint) See the[AI presentation generator](https://flintk12.com/tools/ai-presentation-generator) for an example.


## 🎥 Video voice, language, and speaking rate customization


Make generated videos work for every learner in your classroom. Choose from 9 distinct voice options, generate videos in multiple languages (with both narration and on-screen text translated), and adjust speaking rate for ELL students or accessibility needs.[Learn more about video customization.](https://help.flintk12.com/en/articles/13899068-video-generation-in-flint)


## 📂 Activity folders


Goodbye, endless scrolling. Hello, folders! You can now create folders and group related activities by unit, topic, or time period. Drag and drop activities into folders, rename them as your curriculum evolves, and share organized materials with co-teachers in your group.[Learn more about organizing with folders.](https://help.flintk12.com/en/articles/14724883-how-to-organize-activities-with-folders)


## 📊 Multi-dimensional rubrics


Go beyond single-score grading with rubrics that assess multiple skills at once. Define categories like "Content Knowledge" and "Grammar," set performance levels for each, and let Flint automatically grade student work across all dimensions.[Learn more about rubrics in Flint.](https://help.flintk12.com/en/articles/14872601-using-rubrics-in-flint)


## 🖼️ Images and graphs in documents


Sparky can now generate images and graphs directly inside documents. Ask for a diagram of the digestive system, a bar chart comparing data, or an illustration to bring a concept to life and it appears right where you need it. Visual learners get more engaging materials, and you spend less time hunting for the perfect clipart.[Learn more about document generation.](https://help.flintk12.com/en/articles/15002993-document-generation-in-flint)


## 🧠 Upgrading to Sonnet 4.6


Flint now runs on Anthropic's latest Claude Sonnet 4.6 model, bringing smarter responses, better reasoning, and improved accuracy across all of Sparky's capabilities.
